provenance_note: SEED DATASET — ILLUSTRATIVE ESTIMATES ONLY. Every value in this catalog is an illustrative estimate derived from public quality trends for GGUF quantization and simple memory-bandwidth reasoning per hardware profile. These are NOT measured results, and no citations, DOIs or paper claims are made. All entries carry provenance='seed_estimate' and exist only so the leaderboard renders before real runs exist. They are replaced by provenance='measured' entries produced by kaggle_10pillar_bench.py when the runner executes against a real llama-server. source_url fields point to Hugging Face repo pages.
